tasks.description: Harden the Java backend, externalize database configuration, and secure servlet/JWT handling.
tasks.requirements: Replace hardcoded Oracle connection strings and credentials with environment-based config, remove duplicate Maven dependencies, and tighten session and JWT validation.

tasks.description: Secure the Node.js API gateway by externalizing secrets, enforcing CORS, applying helmet/rate limiting, and strengthening JWT middleware.
tasks.requirements: Replace hardcoded backend URLs and secret strings with environment variables, add request validation, and block invalid or expired JWTs.

tasks.description: Modernize the React frontend by removing hardcoded API/WS endpoints and centralizing runtime configuration.
tasks.requirements: Use environment-configured base URLs for API and WebSocket calls, remove hardcoded localhost dependencies, and improve client-side auth handling.

tasks.description: Centralize configuration and secrets across Java, Node, and frontend components using environment variables.
tasks.requirements: Add .env examples, remove secrets from source, document runtime configuration, and ensure all services read secrets from config rather than code.

tasks.description: Clean Maven and npm dependency configurations, remove duplicates, and stabilize build scripts.
tasks.requirements: Fix Maven plugin versions, remove invalid package.json file references, upgrade outdated dependencies, and ensure project builds reproducibly.

tasks.description: Prepare the application for professional deployment by adding production-ready configuration, deployment guidance, and containerization readiness.
tasks.requirements: Define production environment variables, add deployment readiness documentation, and ensure the app can be deployed without localhost-specific settings.

metadata.planName: Full Stack Modernization for Hybrid Secure Voting System
